title: Retry failed outbox deliveries with backoff
context:
Deliveries that fail once are currently dropped. The outbox table already records status per row, so a retry sweep can key on it without schema change.

Out of frame: dead-lettering and operator alerts. This plan only makes a failed delivery try again.

decisions.decision: Sweep on a timer, not on write
decisions.why: a write-triggered retry retries into the same outage that just failed

adr.consequences: retries lag by up to one sweep period; delivery load is bounded by the sweep, not by write bursts

decisions.decision: Track retries on the outbox row
decisions.why: a separate retries table doubles the writes and the sweep would have to join it on every pass

contracts.reach: the delivery worker is the single consumer; the timer sweep reads both new columns
contracts.decisionRef: Track retries on the outbox row

verifiedFacts.claim: outbox rows carry a status column
the delivery worker is the single consumer

risks.risk: backoff cap has not been agreed; starting at 5 tries

diagrams.question: How does a failed write get retried?
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  W[write] --> O[(outbox)] --> D[deliver]
  D -- fail --> O
  T[timer sweep] --> O

deliverables.title: Retry sweep
deliverables.body: A timer job that re-queues failed rows under the backoff cap.

deliverables.title: Backoff bookkeeping
deliverables.body: Attempt count and next-try-at on the outbox row.

quiz.prompt: A delivery fails while the downstream is mid-outage. What happens next?
options: the writer blocks until delivery succeeds
the row waits for the next timer sweep
the row is dropped after one try
the worker retries inline three times
quiz.why: retry rides the sweep so it lands after the outage, not during it
quiz.decisionRef: Sweep on a timer, not on write

quiz.prompt: Which table changes shape under this plan?
quiz.why: increment 2 adds attempt count and next-try-at to the outbox row
quiz.decisionRef: Track retries on the outbox row

quiz.prompt: What does this plan do with a row that exhausts its 5 tries?
quiz.why: dead-lettering is explicitly out of frame; exhausted rows stay failed
